Dear [Mrs Molesworth](/person/1028)
I am very sorry there has been such a delay in answering your letter.

All those directed to the office were delaying in coming to me by a mistake
I shall be very glad to see your MS if you will still send it to me, it had better come direct here, to save time[^2]

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: Envelope addressed to ‘Mrs Molesworth 85 Lexham Gardens/Kensington/ W London’ postmarked No 10 85.
[^2]: Mary Louisa Molesworth, \'One Sunday Morning\' MP 3s 11 (April 1886) 327-337.
